scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a minute! You're
carrying too many items
right now: store some of
your extra things in Kafra
Storage, and then come back.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！你现在携带的物品太多了：请将多余的东西存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're not sure why, but
this guy seems to be pretty
depressed. He briefly makes
eye contact with you, but then
breaks it off. Apparently,
he wants to be left alone.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你不确定原因，但这家伙看起来相当沮丧。他短暂地与你目光接触，随即移开了视线。显然，他想一个人待着。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's no reason for you
to stick around an ownerless
stronghold. You may as well
head on your way.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你没必要在一个没有主人的据点逗留。你最好还是离开吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you're back. So did you
rest up enough? I'm sure the
other guild members are
feeling refreshed by now.
From the looks of it, you're
ready for your next mission.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你回来了。休息得足够了吗？我想其他公会成员现在应该也恢复精神了。
看你的样子，已经准备好迎接下一个任务了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The next step for
you is to take this, the
''Spirit of Trust.'' If this
guild is going to be solid,
you need to think how much
trust there is in the guild.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的下一步是领取这个“信赖之心”。
如果这个公会要稳固发展，你需要思考公会中有多少信任。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your second test will be
to give that ^4D4DFFSpirit of Trust^000000
to a sage that can manipulate
nature's attributes. In other
words, a Sage or Scholar
must carry out this task.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的第二个考验是将^4D4DFF信赖之心^000000交给一位能操纵自然属性的贤者。
换句话说，必须由贤者或学者来完成这项任务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Spirit of Trust must
be delivered to ^4D4DFF{1}^000000,
so don't forget to relay
that information to your
Sage or Scholar. Very well,
good luck on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
信赖之心必须交给^4D4DFF{1}^000000，
所以别忘了把这个信息转达给你的贤者或学者。
很好，祝旅途顺利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, did you rest we-- Oh.
Why do you look so pale?
You can't accomplish great
deeds when you're overworked!
Rest. Your guild must be able
to depend on your strength.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，你休息得还——哦。
你脸色怎么这么苍白？
过度劳累是无法成就大事的！
休息一下吧。你的公会必须能依靠你的力量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your determination and
spirit is commendable, but
have the patience to recollect
yourself when you must. I will
be waiting here, so please
come back to me later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的决心和精神值得称赞，
但也要有耐心，在需要时调整状态。
我会在这里等你，请稍后再回来找我。

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

我会在这里等你，请稍后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, you look well rested,
master. It is now time for
you to proceed with the third
test. Let me remind you that
these spirits are incredibly
precious. Do not lose them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，你看起来休息得很好，师父。
现在是时候进行第三个考验了。
让我提醒你，这些“心”极其珍贵。千万不要弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Like all the other spirits,
please keep this one safely.
This is the ^4D4DFFSpirit of Peace^000000.
It seems contradictive that
strongholds and might can
bring peace, but it's true.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
和其他“心”一样，请妥善保管这个。
这是^4D4DFF和平之心^000000。
虽然据点和武力能带来和平听起来有些矛盾，但这是事实。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If power isn't used to
protect the weak, then
some bully, in one form or
another, will always come
to exploit them. That is why
Tristan III built the strongholds.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果力量不用于保护弱者，
那么总会有恶霸以某种形式出现来剥削他们。
这就是特里斯坦三世建立据点的原因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please dispatch a Rogue
or Stalker to bring this
Spirit of Peace to ^4D4DFF{1}^000000.
If you don't know any Rogues
or Stalkers, then it would be
prudent for you to meet one.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请派遣一名流氓或神行太保将和平之心带到^4D4DFF{1}^000000。
如果你不认识流氓或神行太保，那么认识一个会是明智之举。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, there's no substitute
for the subterfuge and intel
gathering that a Rogue can
provide. Anyway, {1} will
guide you on your third test.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，流氓提供的潜行和情报收集是无价之宝。
总之，{1}会指导你完成第三个考验。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, did you rest we-- Oh.
Why do you look so pale?
You can't accomplish great
deeds when you're overworked!
Rest. Your guild must be able
to depend on your strength.

[{0}]
啊，你休息得还——哦。

过度劳累是无法成就大事的！
休息一下吧。你的公会必须能依靠你的力量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your determination and
spirit is commendable, but
have the patience to recollect
yourself when you must. I will
be waiting here, so please
come back to me later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的决心和精神值得称赞，
但也要有耐心，在需要时调整状态。
我会在这里等你，请稍后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, have you rested well,
master? Please excuse my
manners a while ago. I had
to report your trial results,
and lost my composure for a
moment. It won't happen again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，师父，你休息得好吗？
请原谅我刚才的失礼。
我必须汇报你的考验结果，一时失态了。
不会再发生了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! M-master? Wh-when
did you...? I'm so sorry.
I was busy working.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！师...师父？你...你什么时候...？
对不起。
我刚才在忙工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's only been a few days
since you finished the trials.
For now, you should rest and
take care of your guild, okay?
Please come back later.
I've got much to attend to...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你完成考验才过了几天。
现在你应该休息并照顾你的公会，好吗？
请稍后再回来。
我还有很多事要处理...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good day, master.
Is something wrong?
You look as though
something is on your mind.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
日安，师父。
有什么事吗？
你看起来心事重重。

scripts.text: N-no, nothing.
scripts.translation: 不，没什么。

scripts.text: I want to take a lesson.
scripts.translation: 我想接受一次考验。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm? That's strange.
You didn't want to take
the trials again, did you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？这很奇怪。
你难道不想再次接受考验吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. You know it won't
be easy, but I suppose you
are prepared. Here, take
the ^4D4DFFSpirit of Guild^000000, and
give it to your most trusted
Knight or Lord Knight.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。你知道这并不容易，但我相信你已经做好了准备。
请收下^4D4DFF公会之心^000000，
并将其交给你最信任的骑士或骑士领主。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This Knight should take
the Spirit of Guild over
to ^4D4DFF{1}^000000. Good luck, and
may the gods be with you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这位骑士应该将公会之心带到^4D4DFF{1}^000000那里。
祝你好运，愿神明保佑你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You still have the Spirit of
Guild I gave you? I suppose
you haven't found a Knight or
Lord Knight to which it can
be entrusted. It is imperative
that you find someone soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还留着给你的公会之心吗？
看来你还没找到可以托付的骑士或骑士领主。
你必须尽快找到合适的人选。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
For the sake of the guild, it
will be advantageous to have
a Knight or Lord Knight on
your side: their combat skills
can turn the tide of battles.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为了公会的利益，拥有一位骑士或骑士领主会很有利：
他们的战斗技巧可以扭转战局。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When you do find a Knight,
give him the Spirit of Guild
and ask him to find {1}
since he will conducting
the trial. Good luck
to you, master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当你找到骑士时，
将公会之心交给他，
并让他去找{1}，
因为将由他主持考验。
祝你好运，师父。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, is this the Spirit
of Advance? This must mean
that you completed the first
test. Keep up the good work.
Hand me the spirit, and allow
me to give you your guild's reward.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，这是进阶之心吗？
看来你完成了第一关考验。
干得好。
把心交给我，让我给你公会的奖励。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You've done well, but
there are more trials
ahead of you. For now,
you should rest before
undertaking the second test.
Please come when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得很好，
但前方还有更多的考验。
现在，
你应该在第二关考验前好好休息。
请准备好后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you're not busy, then
why don't you spend your
time increasing morale
among your guild members?
Perhaps some team building
exercise can be of help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你不忙的话，
为什么不花点时间提升公会成员的士气呢？
也许一些团队建设活动会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must be having
trouble finding {1}.
Make sure that you have
a Sage or Scholar friend
give that Spirit of Trust to
him once you locate him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你一定在找{1}时遇到了困难。
确保你有一位贤者或学者朋友，
一旦找到他，就将信赖之心交给他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, so you already completed
the test and earned the Spirit
of Friendship? Good work.
You must now recognize the
value of teamwork. Please give
the Spirit of Friendship to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，你已经完成了考验并获得了友情之心？
干得好。
你现在必须认识到团队合作的价值。
请把友情之心交给我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now, please take this
reward and share it with
your guild members. This
may come in handy in future
challenges that you will all
face together. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，请收下这份奖励，
并与你的公会成员分享。
这在你们共同面对未来的挑战时可能会有用。
干得好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You should rest and
recuperate before you
undertake the third test.
I too would benefit from
a brief respite. Please come
back to me when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在第三关考验前，
你应该休息并复原。
我也需要短暂的喘息。
请准备好后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you're not busy, then
why don't you spend your
time increasing morale
among your guild members?
Perhaps some team building
exercise can be of help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你不忙的话，
为什么不花点时间提升公会成员的士气呢？
也许一些团队建设活动会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If it suits your fancy,
you may simply come here
and join me for a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你愿意的话，
可以来这里和我一起喝杯茶。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You still have the
Spirit of Peace? If you
don't have any Rogues or
Stalkers in your guild, now
would be the time to recruit
them. Heed my advice...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还留着和平之心吗？
如果你的公会里没有流氓或神行太保，
现在正是招募他们的时候。
请听从我的建议...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see that you've completed
the last test and received
the Spirit of Victory. Heh.
Victory is the natural result
when your guild works together
in harmony as a united team.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来你完成了最后一关考验并获得了胜利之心。
呵。
当公会作为一个团结的团队和谐合作时，
胜利是自然而然的结果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Congratulations on
completing all the trials.
Please accept this reward,
given on the behalf of King
Tristan III, and share it with
guild. Once again, good work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
恭喜你完成了所有考验。
请收下这份奖励，
这是代表特里斯坦三世国王赐予的，
请与公会分享。
再次祝贺你，干得好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You and your guild must be
quite tired now. Your rooms
are ready for you if you decide
to rest. Please visit me again
if you wish to take the trials
again. I'll see you later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你和你的公会一定累坏了吧。
如果你们想休息，房间已经准备好了。
如果想再次接受考验，请随时再来找我。
后会有期。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you aren't particularly
busy, then why don't you
spend some time with your
guild members? Building
strong camaraderie never
fails to pay off. Never.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你不忙的话，
为什么不花点时间和公会成员相处呢？
建立牢固的友谊总是会有回报的。
绝对如此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Greetings, master.
I am {1}, one of the four
Great Sages, and I am here
to serve you under the orders
of wise and benevolent
King Tristan III.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
向您致敬，师父。
我是{1}，四大贤者之一，
奉明智仁慈的特里斯坦三世国王之命，
前来为您效劳。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We test guilds that own
strongholds, and see if they
are qualified to be considered
elite guilds. Our goal is to
train guilds to strengthen
our military forces.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们测试拥有据点的公会，
以确认它们是否有资格被视为精英公会。
我们的目标是训练公会，
以增强我们的军事力量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Although your guild has the
strength and courage to conquer
a stronghold, we want you to
prove that your guild has
a strong sense of justice,
honor, and compassion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
虽然你的公会有征服据点的力量和勇气，
但我们希望你们证明，
你们的公会拥有强烈的正义感、
荣誉感和同情心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is up to you. Will
you take the test I have
for you? I will do my best to
help your guild grow stronger
so that you will be better
able to protect the weak.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这取决于你。
你愿意接受我为你准备的考验吗？
我会尽力帮助你的公会变得更强，
以便你们能更好地保护弱者。

scripts.text: I want to take the test.
scripts.translation: 我想接受考验。

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that so? In this test,
you will be given orders
and special spirits. These
spirits will only be given
once: you must not lose them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是吗？在这次考验中，
你会收到命令和特殊的精灵。
这些精灵只会发放一次：
你绝不能弄丢它们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you lose the spirit,
you will be judged as
irresponsible, and will be
unable to complete the tests.
You must find any lost spirit to
proceed. There's no second chance.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你弄丢了精灵，
你将被判定为不负责任，
并且无法完成考验。
你必须找回任何丢失的精灵才能继续。
没有第二次机会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are a few things you
should know. Firstly, you can
only take care of one spirit
at a time. Secondly, you need
to do the tests in order and
follow the guide's instructions.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有几件事你应该知道。
首先，你一次只能照顾一个精灵。
其次，你需要按顺序进行考验，
并遵循向导的指示。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thirdly, the spirit should
be given to the type of person
specified in the test. Those
are the rules. Remember them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
第三，精灵应该交给考验中指定的类型的人。
这些就是规则。请记住它们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

^FF000030 Frills^000000,
^FF000030 Sharp Papers^000000, and
^FF000030 Elder Pixie's Moustaches^000000.

^FF000030个褶边^000000，

^FF000030根老妖精胡须^000000。
这次可别再忘了。

kill some time. Easy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

打发一下时间。很简单吧？

some time. You can do
whatever you want to
do during that time.

[{0}]

在这段时间里，
你可以做任何你想做的事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

relaxed and enjoyed yourself.

don't you worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

come back to me later.

[{0}]

打发一下时间，
稍后再回来找我。

will be so hard, but I'm
going to give you a much
different challenge now.
Are you ready for it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你明白了吗？

但我现在要给你一个
完全不同的挑战。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your test will be to
grow a little stronger!
You'll pass once you
gain 3 more levels.
How about that, eh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的测试是
变得更强一点！
当你再提升3级时
就会通过。
怎么样，嗯？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

grow a little stronger!
You'll pass once you
gain 2 more levels.
How about that, eh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的测试是
变得更强一点！
当你再提升2级时
就会通过。
怎么样，嗯？

变得更强一点！

[{0}]
Wait a minute. Forget it!
I was going to ask you to
raise your Base Level, but

to a ^FF0000Hunter^000000 or ^FF0000Sniper^000000 now~
scripts.translation:

enough to pass this test.
Hurry up, kill some monsters,
and gain some ^FF0000Base Levels^000000.
You have to become stronger!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还不够强，
无法通过这项测试。
快点，去杀些魔物，
提升一些^FF0000基础等级^000000。
你必须变得更强！

[{0}]

Now, my request for you
is this: please donate
your Falcon for the
sake of your guild.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，很好，你来了。
现在，我对你的要求是：
请为了你的公会，
捐献你的猎鹰。

scripts.text: Donate Falcon
scripts.translation: 捐献猎鹰

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 绝对不行！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great! Don't worry,
your Falcon will be safe
under our care, and will
be use to scout areas and
deliver mail. That's why
I asked you for it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了！别担心，
你的猎鹰会在我们的
照顾下安然无恙，
并用于侦察区域
和送信。这就是我
向你索要它的原因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

spirit, and give it to
your guild master as
soon as you can, alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，请收下这颗心，
并尽快将其交给你的公会会长，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

willing to part with your
Falcon, but it doesn't seem
to be with you right now.
Go get one, and come back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很高兴你愿意交出你的猎鹰，
但它似乎现在不在你身边。
去把它找来，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I can't help it if you
really want to keep your
Falcon, but please come
back if you change your mind.
I can't do anything for you
unless you cooperate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，如果你真的想保留你的猎鹰，
我也没办法，但如果你改变主意了，
请随时回来。
除非你配合，否则我什么都做不了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please give the
Spirit of Charge to
a ^FF0000Blacksmith^000000 or ^FF0000Mastersmith^000000.
It won't do any good in the
hands of anybody else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请将冲锋之心交给^FF0000铁匠^000000或^FF0000神工匠^000000。
交给其他人是没有用的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You don't have
anything to do?
Why don't you help
your guild hunt monsters?
It'll be a good chance to
show them your skills~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你没什么事要做吗？
为什么不帮你的公会讨伐魔物呢？
这是展示你实力的好机会~

scripts.text:
[{0}]

Spirit of Association to

hands of anybody else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请将协同之心交给^FF0000炼金术士^000000或^FF0000生物化学家^000000。
交给其他人是没有用的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm. Don't you have
anything to do? I suppose
it's better to be bored
than to be overwhelmed.
Oh well, you'll figure
something out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。你没什么事要做吗？
我想，无聊总比不知所措要好。
算了，你会想出办法的。

[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请将调和之心交给^FF0000猎人^000000或^FF0000神射手^000000。
交给其他人是没有用的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

and then come back to me

to give you by then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

稍后再回来找我。
到时候我会给你一些东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

Spirit of Advance

hands of anybody else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请将前进之心交给你的^FF0000公会会长^000000。
交给其他人是没有用的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

a great help in the
guild. Hm? You already
miss it? Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

嗯？你已经想念它了？
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]

here? I don't think we
have any business to
conduct. Am I mistaken?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

业务需要处理。我搞错了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

here? Feel free to take
your time and look around
if that's what pleases you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？你来这里做什么？
如果你只是想四处看看，
请随意，慢慢看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

around here, but you're
welcome to stay and look
around here if you wish.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

但如果你愿意，
欢迎留下来四处看看。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a minute! You're
carrying too many items
right now: store some of
your extra things in Kafra
Storage, and then come back.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！你现在携带的物品太多了：请将多余的东西存入卡普拉仓库，然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis exhausted man
notices you staring at
him, but chooses to leave
you alone. There's no one
else in this stronghold so
there's no reason to be here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个疲惫的男人
注意到你在盯着他看，
但他选择让你独自待着。
这个据点里没有其他人，
所以你没必要在这里。^000000

[{0}]
Hm? What are you doing?
You're not supposed to
be the one holding onto
this soul. A Sage or a
Professor was supposed
to come here with it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？你在做什么？
拿着这个灵魂的应该是你。
应该是由贤者或智者
带着它来到这里的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

that soul you're holding
to a ^FF0000Sage^000000 or ^FF0000Professor^000000, and
then have him bring it to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
确保把你手中的灵魂
交给^FF0000贤者^000000或^FF0000智者^000000，
然后让他把它带给我。

[{0}]

not busy, why don't you try
helping out your guild? Yes,
I'm sure they'd appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们之间的事情已经结束了。
如果你不忙，
为什么不帮帮你的公会呢？
是的，我相信他们会感激你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

the ^42426FSpirit of Trust^000000. Now, the
first thing I want you to do is
to build the trust between you
and your guild members.
Spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来你带来了^42426F信赖之心^000000。
现在，我想让你做的第一件事
是建立你与公会成员之间的信任。
多花点时间陪陪他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want you to build
up some friendly bonds
within your guild before
coming back to me. Your
guild must have solidarity
in order to be successful.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在你回来找我之前，
我希望你能在公会内
建立一些友好的纽带。
公会必须团结一致才能成功。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So did you spend some
quality time with your
guild members, and get
a chance to really learn
who they are? You must
love your comrades.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，你和公会成员们
共度了一段美好的时光，
并真正了解了他们吗？
你一定很爱你的同志们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now you know how
important bonding truly
is. Please give this spirit
to a ^42426FBard^000000, ^42426FMinstrel^000000, ^42426FDancer^000000,
or ^42426FGypsy^000000. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在你知道建立羁绊
有多重要了。请把这个灵魂
交给^42426F诗人^000000、^42426F宫廷乐师^000000、^42426F舞娘^000000
或^42426F冷艳舞姬^000000。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm? Back so soon?
That hasn't been enough
time for you to really bond
with your guild members.
Go back, ask them about their
dreams, passions, and goals!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？这么快就回来了？
这点时间还不够你
真正与公会成员建立羁绊。
回去吧，问问他们的
梦想、热情和目标！

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

也可以交给^42426F舞娘^000000或^42426F冷艳舞姬^000000

[{0}]

teamwork amongst your guild,
my test will be for you to
gather specific items for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为了促进公会内部的
团队合作，我的测试是
让你为我收集特定的物品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a difficult task
to complete alone, but it
will be much easier if you
and your guild cooperate to
get all the items. Now listen,
this is what I want you to get.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
独自完成这项任务
很困难，但如果你
和你的公会合作
收集所有物品，就会容易得多。
听好了，
这是我要你收集的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^8C171730 Burning Hearts^000000,
^8C171730 Wolf Claws^000000, and
^8C171730 Leopard Claws^000000.
You might want to write
these down so you don't
forget. Good luck to you.

[{0}]
^8C171730 Soft Blades of Grass^000000,
^8C171730 Wooden Hearts^000000, and
^8C171730 Poisonous Toad Skins^000000.
You might want to write
these down so you don't
forget. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^8C171730柔软的草叶^000000、
^8C171730树木心脏^000000和
^8C171730牛蛙之皮^000000。
你可能需要把这些
记下来以免忘记。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^8C171730 Antelope Horns^000000,
^8C171730 Honey Pots^000000, and
^8C171730 Porcupine Quills^000000.

these down so you don't
forget. Good luck to you.

[{0}]

with your guild while you

you to bring. I know enough
time hasn't passed for your
guild to work together on this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在收集我让你带来的
那些物品时，你应该
正在与公会建立羁绊。
我知道时间还不够长，
不足以让你们公会
为此合作。

[{0}]

best for you to rest and
recoup your strength. Your

will come soon enough so
there's no need to rush.

[{0}]

恢复体力。帮助公会的机会
很快就会到来，
所以不必着急。

for the right time to act.
Why don't you help out
your guild in the meantime?

[{0}]

正确的时机再行动。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see that you have
the potential to become
a great leader. Be sure
not to waste it, and lead
your guild as well as you can.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来你有成为
伟大领袖的潜力。务必
不要浪费它，并尽你所能
领导你的公会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You need to give
the ^FF0000Spirit of Victory^000000
to your Guild Master.
Please make sure that
it gets delivered soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你需要将^FF0000胜利之心^000000
交给你的公会会长。
请确保尽快送达。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're a nenown explorer,
and I see in you the potential
to accomplish even more
great things. However,
I doubt there is anything
more that you can do here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是一位诺恩的探索者，
我看出你有潜力
成就更伟大的事业。然而，
我怀疑这里
已无你可为之事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm. You have no business
being here. Why don't you
find something productive
to do? There is nothing
for you here, I assure you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。你不该出现在这里。
何不找点有意义的事做？
我向你保证，
这里对你毫无用处。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You might be the master
of a guild, but you and I
have nothing to do with
each other. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你或许是公会的会长，
但你和我
毫无关系。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then again, I suppose
you came here to see
how a real guild operates.
If that's the case, you're
welcome to stay and observe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，我想你
来这里是为了看看
真正的公会是如何运作的。
如果是这样，
欢迎留下来观察。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What brings you here?
I don't think I've seen
you around before. Hm.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么事把你带到这儿？
我想我从未见过你。
嗯。
